else.reason: Company Name is historical for null Current Name Indicator records and is supplied through the Current Name mapping

then.reason: Current Name Indicator is present, so Current Name is not the current company name for this branch
Type RACN means the ACN field holds an ARBN, which has no supported entity.acn value
Documented placeholder value 0 means the company has no ABN

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Company name as it appears on the register
field_mappings.transformation: Emit the trimmed raw Company Name only when Current Name Indicator equals Y, since that flag marks the displayed name as the current company name; for null-indicator records this branch is omitted and the documented current name is supplied by the Current Name mapping.
When Current Name Indicator is null, emit the trimmed Current Name as the current legal name for this historical record; when Current Name Indicator equals Y, omit this branch.
When Type equals RACN the ACN field holds an ARBN and is omitted; otherwise parse the ACN as a typed ACN identifier and validate its checksum without requiring a label.
Treat the documented placeholder value 0 as no ABN and omit it; otherwise parse the ABN as a typed ABN identifier and validate its checksum without requiring a label.
Map only the documented code DRGD to deregistered; all other documented status codes are omitted because no same-field equivalence is established for them.
Map the documented company type codes APTY, APUB and FNOS to company; RACN and any other code are omitted.

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Date on which a company was registered
field_mappings.transformation: Parse the documented DD/MM/YYYY date with format %d/%m/%Y without inferring a timezone or validity period.

unmapped_fields.reason: Documented as the state where the company was originally registered, not a current business address; it is not address.state for the subject.
Documented as a state registration number, which has no supported ontology field.
Documented as a flag that the record was modified since the last report; it is not an entity claim.
Documented as Class of company; no supported canonical field exists in this ontology subset.
Documented as Sub Class of company; no supported canonical field exists in this ontology subset.
Documented as the date the company was deregistered; no supported canonical field exists and it does not establish whole-observation validity.
Documented as a flag for whether the displayed name is current; it is used only as a predicate dependency for the name mappings and is not a standalone canonical output.
Documented as the start date of the current name; no supported canonical field exists.
Internal native record identifier with no documented business meaning for the canonical ontology.
Status codes other than DRGD have no same-field supported canonical equivalence in this proposal and are not mapped.
